title: Acme Mutual claims: system shape
subtitle: What shape the claims application should have.

verdict.text: A modular monolith on one app platform: one team, no platform engineers.

blocks.text: One deployable with modules for claims, documents and reporting. 5 engineers and no platform team rule out running several services.

facts.scope: The shape of the Acme Mutual claims application

decisions.title: System shape
decisions.because: One team of 5, no platform engineers.

decisions.title: Hosting
decisions.chosen: One container on the app platform
decisions.because: No platform team to run a cluster.

assumptions: Team of 5 engineers and no platform team.
